name: Seasonal/Time System - Time Passage & Seasonal Effects

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign) WHERE c.status = 'active' RETURN c.id as campaignId, c.worldState as worldState, c.timeData as timeData, c.lastTimeUpdate as lastUpdate, c.settings as campaignSettings

parameters.name: messages
query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) SET c.timeData = {{ JSON.stringify($json.time_state_updates) }}, c.lastTimeUpdate = '{{ $json.timestamp }}', c.timeHistory = COALESCE(c.timeHistory, []) + [{{ JSON.stringify({ advancement_id: $json.time_summary.time_advancement_id, summary: $json.time_summary, events: $json.enriched_events }) }}] RETURN c
